turns.content: How much leave do I get?

expected.reference_answer: Meridian provides several types of leave including annual leave (24 days), sick leave, parental leave, and bereavement leave. Which specific leave type would you like details on?

turns.content: Annual leave, the paid one.

expected.reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued monthly from the date of joining.

turns.content: And what happens to the days I don't use?

expected.reference_answer: You can carry forward up to 12 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year; any remaining unused carried-forward days lapse on 31 March.

turns.content: You said they expire in March - is there any exception for long-tenured staff?

expected.reference_answer: Yes, employees who joined Meridian before 1 January 2020 have an extended transitional grace period allowing carried-forward days to be used until 30 April.

turns.content: Summarise that as three bullet points I can send my manager.

expected.reference_answer:
- 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
- Up to 12 unused days can be carried forward, expiring on 31 March.
- Pre-2020 joiners have an extended grace period until 30 April.
24 days annual leave, 12 may be carried forward, unused carried days lapse on 31 March except for pre-2020 joiners who have until 30 April.
